## Names

<a id="missile_launch"></a>
### [`missile_launch`](../../../../src/missile/missile_launch.asm#L6) `$5790`

*routine*

Launches a missile on every 8th tick when jet_speed_x <> 0 and AAM > 0. Fills a free slot, subtracts 1 from AAM, starts the shot sound.

- **Called from:** [`read_input`](../input/read_input.md#read_input) [`$5789`](../../../../src/input/read_input.asm#L86)
- **Reads:** [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`jet_speed_x`](../../memory-map.md#jet_speed_x), [`aam_count`](../../memory-map.md#aam_count), [`aam_count+1`](../../memory-map.md#aam_count), [`aam_count+2`](../../memory-map.md#aam_count), [`temp2`](../../memory-map.md#temp2), [`SP0Y`](../../memory-map.md#SP0Y), [`jet_state`](../../memory-map.md#jet_state)
- **Writes:** [`temp2`](../../memory-map.md#temp2), [`tick`](../../memory-map.md#tick), [`gauge_colour`](../../memory-map.md#gauge_colour), [`aam_count+2`](../../memory-map.md#aam_count), [`aam_count+1`](../../memory-map.md#aam_count), [`aam_count`](../../memory-map.md#aam_count), [`VCREG2`](../../memory-map.md#VCREG2)
